quests.title: Up the side of the wall
quests.ask: Get the robot along the bottom and up the side of the wall to the marked cell, at the top corner.
quests.nudge: Count the cells along each side of the wall before you write a line.

quests.title: Across the top to the gem
quests.ask: Carry on from the top corner along the top of the wall, then pick up the gem.
quests.nudge: At the top corner the robot faces up the screen. Which way must it face next?
